title: Orange gowns & red EXIT signs | Conformity Gate Part 3

shots.vo: Clue number two. Fans pointed out the graduates wore orange, not the green many tied to Hawkins High. Some joked it looked more like a prison uniform.
shots.prompt: Bright orange graduation gowns hanging in a row in a dim 1980s school locker room, slow push-in, a single overhead light

shots.vo: Then they spotted glowing red EXIT signs behind the couples in the happy ending. A perfect world... with the way out hidden in plain sight.
shots.prompt: An empty 1980s diner booth at night, a glowing red EXIT sign on the wall behind it, slow zoom toward the sign, red neon pulsing gently
A dark corridor ending in a single glowing red EXIT sign, fog drifting toward the camera, slow dolly forward

caption: Clue #2: orange gowns and red EXIT signs in the Stranger Things finale. Coincidence or message? Fan theory. Part 4 tomorrow.
